title: One person, many tools

scenes.say: You are not behind because you are alone.
scenes.visual: a man alone at a desk in a big empty office at night

scenes.say: One person with the right tools can do the work of a team.
scenes.visual: a workbench with tools laid out in neat rows, overhead light

scenes.say: Let the tools handle the repeat work.
scenes.visual: a row of machines running in a quiet workshop

scenes.say: Keep your hours for what only you can do.
scenes.visual: a man sketching ideas in a notebook by a window

scenes.say: Talk to customers. Make the thing better.
scenes.visual: two people shaking hands across a counter in a small shop

scenes.say: Stop making excuses and start building systems.
scenes.visual: a hand flipping a large power switch on a wall, close up

scenes.say: Follow for more. Build every day.
scenes.visual: city skyline at sunrise with the first lights coming on

caption: One person with the right tools can do the work of a team.
